claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivatedAbilityMechanics.condition.touching_transformed_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Tree Form's return action is only available while the staff is currently a tree and the user is touching that transformed item. The existing activation-side condition grammar only covers broad equipment predicates like holding or wearing an item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While touching the tree and using a Magic action, you return the staff to its normal form.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.fall_on_end
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Reverting the tree to a staff forces creatures in the tree to fall. That deterministic cleanup rider is not representable in the current surface even though it is part of the item's mechanical resolution.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Any creature in the tree falls when the tree reverts to a staff.
